name: Sivers Semiconductors AB (publ)
blurb: Sivers designs and manufactures indium phosphide (InP) distributed feedback lasers and optical amplifiers used inside high-speed optical transceivers, automotive LiDAR systems and satellite communications terminals. Its photonics business is one of the few independent western sources of the laser dies that go into AI-data-centre optical links, alongside larger incumbents such as Coherent and Lumentum. A separate wireless unit supplies 5G millimetre-wave RF chips. The company has been preparing a spin-off and potential dual Nasdaq New York listing of its photonics subsidiary.
recent: Shares ran from roughly SEK 4 at the start of 2026 to a close of SEK 55.95 in early May, a year-to-date gain of about 1,247%, on customer wins including a 1.6T linear-drive optical module collaboration with Jabil announced 15 April 2026 and a LiDAR ramp scheduled for Q4 2026 with up to $138m of cumulative lifetime revenue. 2025 net sales were SEK 304m (+25% YoY) but the after-tax loss was SEK 186m, prompting an April 2026 directed issue of 8.62m shares at SEK 14.50 raising about SEK 125m at roughly 2.5% dilution. Photonics experts and Swedish business media have publicly questioned whether the rally has run ahead of fundamentals.
